title: Galois representations over convergent de Rham period ring
summary: Let $\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}^{+, \dagger} \subset \mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}^{+}$ be the ``convergent" de Rham period ring which is the (un-completed) stalk at the de Rham point of the Fargues--Fontaine curve. We develop a Tate--Sen formalism to relate Galois representations over $\mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}^{+, \dagger}$ to regular connections over convergent functions.
